    rm -f "$RESPONSE_FILE"
    exit "$CURL_EXIT"

import json

PY

rm -f "$RESPONSE_FILE"

case "$TARGET_EXIT_CODE" in
    0|300) exit 0 ;;
    *) exit 1 ;;
esac
